item.title: Decluttering Ideas for Small Homes That Actually Last
item.description: A small home does not need more storage every time it feels crowded. Often, the practical problem is that too many items have no clear home, a category has no physical limit, or putting something away takes more effort than leaving it out. The most useful decluttering ideas for small homes therefore do two jobs: remove things you do not need and make the things you keep easier to manage. This guide is designed for a real home, not a one-day makeover.
